description: Changes a running flow's steps on a conversation, as the steps on its flow chip do. Each is SET to a state, never toggled, so a replayed call cannot undo itself: setStepDone ticks a step (done true) or unticks it (done false); setStepSkipped marks a step not needed (skipped true) or restores it (false); updateStepDeadline sets a step's deadline_minutes, or clears it with null; addStep appends a step, its title read like the one-line add box ("call back wednesday around 2" carries its own deadline). Change one step state per call (one of setStepDone, setStepSkipped). Ticking the last step closes the flow, as it does for a person. conversation_id is the thread; conversationFlowId names the run when the thread carries more than one active flow (its id comes back from start_conversation_flow or assign_flow). Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; a repeat changes nothing more.

addStep.description: Append a step to this run, its title parsed for a deadline like the add box.

conversationFlowId.description: The run to change, when the thread has more than one active flow.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

setStepDone.description: Tick one step done (true) or undo it (false). Step indices are zero-based, in the order the flow shows them.

setStepSkipped.description: Mark one step not needed (true) or restore it (false). Never counted as done.

updateStepDeadline.description: Move one step's deadline to deadline_minutes from the flow's anchor, or clear it with null.

name: edit_conversation_flow_steps
title: Tick, skip, add or reschedule a step on a running flow
